what: Synchronized index of the numbers reported in the paper tables (mean +/- std over seeds 0-19 unless noted), transcribed from the archived per-seed runs. Per-sample and per-fold evidence: the prediction and selection CSVs in this folder. Every entry is regenerable from the released scripts: nested rows via nested_cv.py, the fixed ablation via analysis/nn_LORO.py --variant all, alternative regressors via analysis/nested_alt_regressors.py, the physics baseline via analysis/baseline_jia.py, linear/polynomial/dummy via analysis/linear_baselines.py, the single-measurement benchmark via comparison/nn_single_dir.py, and the deployed configuration via nested_cv.py --deploy.
